servinfo.title: Water Pump / Generator Drive Belt Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when compressing the water pump / generator drive belt auto tensioner can cause damage to the tensioner.

item.ptxt: Compress the tensioner slowly using hexagonal socket (special tool) with ring wrench.
Do not apply more than 130 N·m (13.3 kgf-m, 96.0 lbf-ft) when compressing the tensioner.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove right side engine under side cover.
For A/C model, remove compressor drive belt.
Attach special tool and turn water pump / generator drive belt auto tensioner (1) counterclockwise as shown until hole (2) is aligned with hole (3).

attention3.ptxt: 6-point ring wrench is recommended to turn the tensioner.

item.ptxt: Keep the pin installed until water pump / generator drive belt is installed.

s1.ptxt: Remove water pump / generator drive belt (5).
Put water pump / generator drive belt (1) on crankshaft pulley, water pump pulley and generator pulley fitting belt ribs to pulley grooves correctly.
Attach special tool and turn water pump / generator drive belt auto tensioner (2) counterclockwise as shown and remove pin (3).
Remove special tool slowly to give tension to the belt.
Turn crankshaft clockwise 720° and check that all of belt ribs are fitted into all of pulley grooves.
Start engine for 2 to 3 seconds to stabilize the belt tension.
Stop engine and check the state of the belt.
For A/C model, install compressor drive belt
Install right side engine under side cover.
